title: What a custom website includes:
titleAccent: five layers, yours at final payment.
subtitle: A template changes the top layer. We design and build all five, and at final payment the code, the database and the accounts are in your name.

interface.name: Interface
interface.detail: Designed around how your customers actually buy, from the first screen to the final action. Every language and right-to-left from the start, WCAG 2.1 AA, built for phones first.
interface.ownership: An interface made for your business, not a theme with your logo dropped in.

components.name: Components
components.detail: Every button, form and section is built once as a reusable part, so new pages keep the same standard as the first ones.
components.ownership: A component system your team or another developer can extend, not a design file that drifts after the first edit.

application.name: Application
application.detail: Your business rules, sign-in, payments and integrations, written as your own code, not plugins.
application.ownership: Logic shaped to how you operate, not a plugin's assumptions bent to fit.

data.name: Data
data.detail: A PostgreSQL database designed for your records, documented so another developer can work on it.
data.ownership: A database you own and can move, not tables locked inside a platform you rent.

infrastructure.name: Infrastructure
infrastructure.detail: Hosting, deployment and environments set up in accounts you control. Monitoring and backups run on a maintenance plan.
infrastructure.ownership: Deployment you hold the keys to: no lock-in, no subscription holding your site.
